source: Three-note chords on the top strings: major and minor, every inversion, and progressions that barely move.
old_translation: Tritonski akordi na zgornjih strunah: dur in mol, vsi obrati ter zaporedja s komaj opaznimi premiki.
translation: Akordi s tremi toni na zgornjih strunah: dur in mol, vsi obrati ter zaporedja s komaj opaznimi premiki.
reason: Tritonski suggests tritone rather than three-note chords.

source: Counting in two
old_translation: Štetje v dvoje
translation: Štetje na dve dobi
reason: V dvoje normally means two people; explicitly names the two-beat meter.

source: Stephen Foster wrote this song in 1848. It counts in two: 1 and 2 and. Most notes are quick eighth notes.
old_translation: Stephen Foster je to pesem napisal leta 1848. Štejemo v dvoje: 1 in 2 in. Večina not so hitre osminke.
translation: Stephen Foster je to pesem napisal leta 1848. Štejemo na dve dobi: 1 in 2 in. Večinoma gre za hitre osminke.
reason: Clarify two-beat counting rather than counting as a pair of people.

source: Dublin's song, in three
old_translation: Dublinska pesem v troje
translation: Dublinska pesem v tridobnem taktu
reason: V troje suggests three people rather than triple meter.

source: On string 4, each fret is one note higher: E, F, F sharp, G, G sharp, then A at fret 5. Fret 5 sounds the same as open string 3.
old_translation: Na struni 4 je vsaka prečka za en ton višje: E, F, F z višajem, G, G z višajem in nato A pri prečki 5. Prečka 5 zveni enako kot prazna struna 3.
translation: Na struni 4 se toni z vsako naslednjo prečko višajo: E, F, F z višajem, G, G z višajem in nato A pri prečki 5. Prečka 5 zveni enako kot prazna struna 3.
reason: En ton višje can imply whole-tone steps; source enumerates chromatic notes.

source: A dotted quarter lasts one and a half beats. Play on 1, hold through 2, then play on the and of 2, then on 3 and 4.
old_translation: Četrtinka s piko traja dobo in pol. Igraj na 1, drži do 2, nato igraj na in za 2, potem na 3 in 4.
translation: Četrtinka s piko traja dobo in pol. Igraj na 1, zadrži še na 2, nato igraj na »in« po 2, potem na 3 in 4.
reason: Preserve sustaining through beat two onset and consistent quoted subdivision syllable.

source: Shift on the open string
old_translation: Menjaj lego med prazno struno
translation: Menjaj lego, ko zveni prazna struna
reason: Med prazno struno omits sounding-time relationship; make instruction natural and precise.

source: A three-note pattern repeated across a bar of eight makes the accent shift each time. That is the rolling feel.
old_translation: Ponavljanje tritonskega vzorca čez takt osmih tonov vsakič premakne poudarek. To ustvari občutek tekočega valovanja.
translation: Ponavljanje vzorca s tremi toni čez takt osmih tonov vsakič premakne poudarek. To ustvari občutek tekočega valovanja.
reason: Avoid ambiguous tritone wording for a three-note pattern.

source: Three-note melodies
old_translation: Tritonske melodije
translation: Melodije s tremi toni
reason: Avoid ambiguous tritone wording for three-note melodies.

source: Count in twos
old_translation: Štej po dve
translation: Štej ena, dve
reason: Clarify grouping in two rather than counting by twos/skipping odd numbers.

source: This B minor uses the top four strings only: fret 4 on strings 4 and 3, fret 3 on string 2, fret 2 on string 1. The full barre comes later.
old_translation: Ta B-mol uporablja le štiri najtanjše strune: prečko 4 na strunah 4 in 3, prečko 3 na struni 2, prečko 2 na struni 1. Polni bare pride pozneje.
translation: Ta B-mol uporablja le štiri najtanjše strune: prečko 4 na strunah 4 in 3, prečko 3 na struni 2, prečko 2 na struni 1. Polni barré pride pozneje.
reason: Align barré spelling with glossary and earlier lessons; use standard compound šestosminski where present.

translation: Če zmoreš, zaigraj polni barré B-mola na prečki 2. Sicer uporabi štiri najtanjše strune: prečko 4 na strunah 4 in 3, prečko 3 na struni 2, prečko 2 na struni 1.

source: Spray Paint Sunrise is indie pop at 124 beats per minute: E, B, C sharp minor and A, the four-chord loop with two barres. Drive steady eighths and let it run.

source: This song rocks in six-eight: two big beats a bar, each split in three. Count one-two-three, four-five-six, like oars pulling and coming back.
old_translation: Ta pesem se ziblje v šest-osminskem taktu: dve veliki dobi v taktu, vsaka razdeljena na tri. Štej ena-dve-tri, štiri-pet-šest, kot vesla, ki zaveslajo in se vrnejo.
